concat_videos_with_ffmpeg: create a VideoAugmenterByConcat to concatenate multiple video files together using FFmpeg
concat_videos_with_transition: create a VideoAugmenterByConcat with a TransitionConfig to add xfade transitions between concatenated videos
generate_ffmpeg_concat_command: call get_command on VideoAugmenterByConcat to generate the FFmpeg CLI command for video concatenation
configure_transition_effect: create a TransitionConfig with a TransitionEffect enum and duration to configure video transitions
list_transition_effects: review the TransitionEffect enum to see all available FFmpeg xfade transition types like DISSOLVE and FADEBLACK
